verificationRetries.initialFailure: A dynamic menu-position.js import failed while other Vite tests/builds were active.
verificationRetries.resolution: Both full ui:test runs passed, and the isolated unchanged interaction suite passed 36/36.

verificationRetries.initialFailure: The new-server selector matched two controls, then its first match was hidden on the initial Plugins page.
verificationRetries.resolution: The harness now opens Connections through the actual navigation and uses the toolbar control; native checks passed without product changes.

tagCorrection.reason: The publication PATCH omitted tag_name; the draft temporary tag became the published tag, so the intended version URL returned 404.
tagCorrection.resolution: PATCHed the same Release to existing v2.2.2, whose source ref was verified. All program/signature asset IDs, sizes and digests remained unchanged; anonymous manifest download and five platform HEAD requests then passed.
tagCorrection.temporaryGitTag: removed after verifying its source and corrected Release

limits: Only the core is released. Shared source/UI/business checks do not imply independently packaged plugin releases or a native remote release-package combination. Local WebView2 used isolated data, CDP input and paused frame inspection. Physical pointer/IME/DPI/multi-display/screen-reader, Linux/macOS native menu gesture, historical upgrade and netem special verification were not performed.
